source_snapshot.items: Network Validation Initial Environment Setup and trial run - Check Telemetry
source_snapshot.procedure: Run IB-Stress between node-1 and node-2, set UFM Telemetry time to Last 5 Minutes, inspect tables and curves.
source_snapshot.criteria: Curves display correctly without abnormal surges or drops.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL/CONFLICTING; recognizes generic live telemetry but attaches unrelated subnet-merger risk and omits the five-minute window and curve oracle.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CHANGED; requires exact panels/units/sampling, bounded load, raw series and numerical continuity/correlation rules.

old_problem: The active review treated unspecified surge/drop tolerances as another review decision. The user-approved parameterization rule explicitly allows project performance thresholds when purpose, method and safety are clear. NVIDIA defines five-minute time-series telemetry; numeric tolerances can be mandatory execution configuration without fabricating PASS.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA UFM supports time-series views over selected counters/devices and raw/calculated port metrics. The source fixes Last 5 Minutes and a bounded 15-minute load allocation. ED-03 permits panel/metric/tolerance bindings, ED-05 isolates IB, ED-14 preserves full load coverage, and ED-15 prohibits PASS until numeric gap/spike/drop/correlation tolerances are approved. This creates a complete review-layer test while leaving project-specific curve thresholds as runtime prerequisites.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row425 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3016 and adjacent row424 alarm plus row426 PHY-diagnostic cases.
Applied NVIDIA UFM Telemetry semantics for selected device/port counters, calculated rates and time-series windows.
Preserved the full 15-minute IB-Stress allocation and exact Last 5 Minutes view while requiring an exported raw series rather than subjective visual judgment alone.
Made numerical surge/drop/gap/variance and endpoint-delta rules mandatory project configuration; absent rules yield INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row426 and verified its manifest identity; no traffic, telemetry query or fabric action ran.

test_case.test_name: Five-minute UFM telemetry curve continuity and endpoint-counter accuracy under bounded IB load
test_case.purpose: Verify selected UFM port telemetry accurately and continuously represents the approved two-node IB workload in the exact Last 5 Minutes window without unexplained missing samples, spikes or drops.
required_package: Approved UFM/version/provider/view and mapped node/link GUID/ports
Pinned finite two-node IB-Stress profile for the complete 900-second source allocation with watchdog
Exact panel/metric/unit list, UFM sample/aggregation/refresh interval and synchronized endpoint counter source
Project-approved missing-sample limit, startup/stop transient window, spike/drop/variance rules, timestamp skew and endpoint-to-UFM tolerance
test_case.test_command: Capture synchronized clocks, idle baseline, mapped endpoint counters and UFM raw exports. Run the approved node-1/node-2 IB load for the complete 900 seconds under a hard watchdog. During a steady interval select Telemetry > Last 5 Minutes and export every approved mapped series plus endpoint counters spanning the same timestamps. Preserve real UI curves/tables, compute missing/duplicate samples, interval deltas, discontinuities, variance and endpoint-normalized rate error using only approved tolerances. Stop traffic, capture return to baseline and post-health.
test_case.expected_result: Every selected series identifies the correct port/metric/unit and covers the complete five-minute window at the documented cadence. Its load rise, steady region and return behavior match synchronized endpoint counters; missing samples, unexplained spikes/drops, steady variation and rate error remain within approved project tolerances, with no link/fabric fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the approved numerical oracle, complete raw five-minute series, matching endpoint counters/timestamps, real UI rendering and all calculated continuity/accuracy results within tolerance. Without approved tolerances, raw export, unit identity or aligned endpoint evidence the result is INCONCLUSIVE—not PASS. Visual smoothness alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Use only the approved isolated IB path and bounded 900-second load with external watchdog
Confirm exact UFM port/metric/unit/sample behavior and clock alignment before comparison
Preserve raw exports and operational logs; do not clear history or change topology/event policy
Abort on link/RAS/fabric/thermal fault, unexpected path or management loss; terminate peers and never auto-retry
expected_evidence: UFM/version/provider/view, node/link/port identity and clock alignment
Approved traffic profile/timeline and full 900-second peer outputs/status
Idle baseline, raw Last-5-Minutes UFM series and synchronized endpoint counters
Real UI screenshots and gap/spike/drop/variance/correlation calculation workbook or JSON
Approved tolerance set, return-to-baseline/post-health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On traffic or telemetry anomaly stop both peers, preserve the raw series and endpoint/fabric evidence, restore temporary network state from the approved load case and verify link/UFM health. Do not smooth, delete or regenerate samples and do not retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The rewrite removes DeepSeek's unrelated subnet-merger risk and restores the exact five-minute telemetry-curve test.

blocked.reason: Purpose/method/safety are complete; numerical curve tolerances are explicitly allowed project configuration prerequisites.
